name: The Spice Melange Trading Desk
description: Education-only, Dune-themed Sui trading desk (Bitcoin = spice). Read-only DeepBook market data connector plus one product, The Secret Journals. No return claims, not financial advice, no private desk data.

products.name: The Secret Journals
products.salesFinal: All sales final, except where the law requires otherwise
howToBuy: Get the owner's explicit yes on the exact payment (asset, amount, from, to).
POST https://thespicemelange.org/api/store/order {"sku":"dune-saga-collection"} -> orderId, token, payTo, coinType, exact amount.
Send exactly that amount in one USDC transfer from the buyer's own wallet to payTo.
POST https://thespicemelange.org/api/store/verify {orderId, token, digest} -> signed download link.

spiceCertificates.requires: Holding The Secret Journals token in the buyer's wallet

notOffered: access to desk records or keys

selfCustodyTrading.status: preview: connector v0.4.0 tools are built and tested but NOT yet deployed to https://plumbline-mcp.fly.dev/mcp
selfCustodyTrading.custody: non-custodial: the desk never creates, holds or sees agent keys and never moves agent funds. Agents generate their own Sui Ed25519 keypair locally, sign locally and submit to a Sui fullnode themselves. No submit tool by design.

tools.wallet_setup_guide: steps + @mysten/sui code to create and fund your own wallet; never share the key
tools.get_swap_quote: from, to, amount, sender -> best route DeepBook v3 vs Cetus aggregator (all DEXes), expected out, price impact, fees, desk fee
tools.build_swap_tx: -> base64 UNSIGNED swap tx (sender = you, on-chain min_out) + mainnet simulation
tools.build_bm_withdraw_tx: withdraw back to your own address
tools.build_limit_order_tx: spot limit order (post-only option, expiry, optional deposit in the same tx); fees in the input coin
tools.build_cancel_order_tx: cancel one or all orders in a pool + withdraw settled
tools.walrus_store_guide: store a PUBLIC receipt/note on Walrus with your own key
tools.check_holder: does this address hold The Secret Journals token (on chain)?
tools.golden_path_market_read: holders only: market read + pre-trade checklist (education only)

flow: fund your address with SUI (gas) + the coin to sell
verify/simulate, sign locally with your own key
submit to a public Sui fullnode yourself
optional: store a public receipt on Walrus

deskFee.mechanism: Cetus routes: aggregator overlay fee; DeepBook routes: fee split from the output in the same transaction. Shown on every quote and visible in the unsigned tx.

selfCustodyTrading.disclaimer: Education only, not financial advice. No returns promised.
